lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now periodically causes him to ignore the next immobilize effect.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Preventing an effect makes him lose 7% of his current health and launches a canister that lands 525 units in the general direction of its source, remaining on the ground for 7 seconds. Dr. Mundo can pick it up to heal himself for 8% of his maximum health and reduce the cooldown of this effect by 15 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Enemy champions can destroy the canister by walking over it before Dr. Mundo reaches it.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Goes Where He Pleases' cooldown resets upon respawning.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Cooldown: 45–15 seconds.

lines.note: Health regeneration reduced to 2% maximum health from 2.5%|health.

lines.note: Health cost reduced to 50 at all ranks from 50–90.

lines.label: Minimum damage
lines.note: Minimum damage increased to 80–300 from 80–280.

lines.label: Maximum damage to monsters
lines.note: Maximum damage to monsters changed to 150–450 from 100–500.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: No longer restores health equal to the full health cost if Infected Bonesaw kills a non-champion.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: Damage is no longer capped at 100–500 against minions.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: No longer a toggle spell.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: No longer grants 30% tenacity while toggled on.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Active: Dr. Mundo charges up a defibrillator for 4 seconds, dealing a total of 80–320 magic damage over the duration, with each tick occuring every 0.25 seconds, to nearby enemies and storing 25–45% of the damage he takes. Heart Zapper can be recast after 1 second for the duration, and does so automatically at the end of the duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Recast: Dr. Mundo detonates the defibrillator, dealing 20–80 (+ 7% bonus health) magic damage to nearby enemies and heal himself for 100% of all the damage stored if at least one enemy is hit, reduced to 50% if no champion is hit.

lines.label: Health cost
lines.before: 10–30 health per second while toggled on
lines.note: Health cost changed to 5% current health on-cast from 10–30 health per second while toggled on.

lines.label: Cooldown
lines.note: Cooldown increased to seconds from seconds at all ranks.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed Passive: Taking magic damage or paying a health cost increases Dr. Mundo's magic resistance by 3% for 2 seconds, stacking up to 2–11 (4 ranks) times.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed Effect: On activation, grants 30–90 bonus attack damage for 5 seconds, increased by an amount based on his percentage health, up to a maximum total of 50–170 at 100% missing health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Passive: Now always passively grants 15–35 bonus attack damage, increased based on his missing health, up to a maximum total of 15+25–35+45 at 70% missing health.

lines.label: Health cost
lines.note: Health cost reduced to 10–50 from 25–65.

lines.label: Cooldown
lines.note: Cooldown increased to 8–6 seconds after the attack from 6–4 seconds on-cast.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Empowered attack's windup is now uncancellable windup.

lines.label: Bonus attack range
lines.note: Bonus attack range increased to 50 from 25.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Attack now applies against structures, consuming the effect and dealing the bonus damage.

lines.label: Damage of the empowered attack
lines.note: Damage of the empowered attack changed to 5–45 (+ 7% bonus health) from 4–6% maximum health.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now increases the bonus damage to the primary target by 0–60% (over 0–40).

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now deals 40% increased damage to minions and non-epic monsters.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now knocks enemies killed by the attack away in a line, dealing 100% AD plus Blunt Force Trauma's minimum bonus damage to other enemies they pass through.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Removed: 25% current health health cost.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now additionally heals him on-cast for 20% of his missing health.

lines.label: Duration
lines.note: Duration reduced to 10 seconds from 12 seconds.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: Now additionally grants (4–7 (3 ranks)% bonus health) bonus attack damage for the duration.

lines.label: Total health regeneration
lines.note: Total health regeneration reduced to 20–70 (3 ranks)% maximum health from 60–110 (3 ranks)%|health.
